# libsmacker in Spellcross Reloaded

This directory vendors libsmacker 1.2.0 from commit
`ae8d4c9ec07b24d43ccff184d6e512bae793dfd1` of
<https://github.com/JonnyH/libsmacker>.

Spellcross Reloaded uses it to decode the original SMK2/SMK4 movies found in
the English, Polish and Italian retail `MOVIE.FS` archives. The upstream files
`smacker.c`, `smacker.h` and `smk_malloc.h` are unmodified. libsmacker is
licensed under LGPL-2.1-or-later; see `COPYING` in this directory.
